claims.object_text: truncation between third and fourth transmembrane domains producing α1Lys374Serfs*25
claims.quote: This truncated the α1 subunit between the third and fourth transmembrane domains and introduced 24 new residues forming the mature protein, α1Lys374Serfs*25

claims.object_text: retention in the endoplasmic reticulum causes severely impaired cell surface expression
claims.quote: Cell surface expression of mutant murine GABAARs is severely impaired compared with WT, due to retention in the endoplasmic reticulum.

claims.object_text: differential coassembly with β3 but not β2 subunits
claims.quote: Mutant receptors were differentially coexpressed with β3, but not with β2, subunits in mammalian cells.
Reduced surface expression was reflected by smaller IPSCs
which may underlie the induction of seizures.
Cell surface expression of mutant murine GABAARs is severely impaired compared with WT, due to retention in the endoplasmic reticulum.
The mutant does not have a dominant-negative effect on native neuronal GABAAR expression since GABA current density was unaffected in hippocampal neurons

claims.object_text: reduced GABA sensitivity of mutant receptors
claims.quote: mutant receptors exhibited limited GABA sensitivity.
